about: The evangelium of the formulary “Queenship of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: At that time, the Angel Gabriel was sent by God into a city of Galilee whose name is Nazareth, to a virgin promised in marriage to a man whose name was Joseph, of David’s house; and the name of the virgin was Mary. And the angel, having come in to her, said: Hail, full of grace, the Lord is with you; blessed are you among women. Having heard this, she was troubled by his words, and she kept wondering what kind of greeting this was. And the angel said to her: Have no fear, Mary, for you have found grace with God. Behold, you will conceive in your womb and will bear a son, and you will call His name Jesus. He will be great, and He will be called the Son of the Most High, and the Lord God will give Him the throne of His father David; and He will reign in the house of Jacob forever, and there will be no end to His kingdom.
